title: How One AI Prompt Made $47K in 24 Hours
angle: Most people use AI to save time. One person used a single prompt to print money — and the prompt itself is embarrassingly simple.

scenes.voiceover: One AI prompt. 24 hours. $47,000. I found the exact prompt — and it's 11 words.
scenes.visual_description: Black screen. White bold numbers slam in one by one: $47,000 — 24 HRS — 1 PROMPT. Each number hits with a flash cut.

scenes.voiceover: A solo founder. No team. No ads. Just ChatGPT, a laptop, and this one prompt nobody talks about.
scenes.visual_description: Rapid cuts: lonely laptop glowing at 2am, ChatGPT interface loading, Stripe dashboard with green numbers spiking upward.
scenes.caption_overlay: No team. No ads. Just this 👇

scenes.voiceover: The prompt: Act as a $10K consultant. Find me a painful problem in X niche and write the sales page to solve it.
scenes.visual_description: Screen recording zooms into a ChatGPT window. The prompt types itself in real-time, letter by letter, then response explodes onto screen.

scenes.voiceover: The output? A full digital product idea, sales copy, and pricing strategy. Done in 4 minutes. He sold it in 24 hours.
scenes.visual_description: Split screen: left side ChatGPT output scrolling fast, right side a Gumroad or Stripe dashboard showing real-time sales notifications pinging.
scenes.caption_overlay: 4 minutes to build. 24 hrs to sell.

scenes.voiceover: While you're using AI to write emails, others are using it to build revenue streams. The gap is widening. Fast.
scenes.visual_description: Red and white kinetic text pulses: YOU vs THEM. Arrow graph shoots upward on THEM side. Clock ticks in corner overlay.

scenes.voiceover: Open ChatGPT. Type that prompt. See what it builds you. Come back and tell me if you hit $47K. I dare you.
scenes.visual_description: Speaker stares dead into camera, then slowly smiles. Text slams back: 1 PROMPT. 24 HRS. $47K. Exact same opening frame — full loop.

hook_test.format_reference: Wait, what? — Hook with surprising claim → proof → bigger reveal
hook_test.viral_proof: Videos using the '$X in Y hours with one trick' structure consistently hit 10M+ views. Examples: 'I made $10K in 48 hours on Etsy' (14M views), 'This one ChatGPT prompt got me 100K followers' (11M views). The formula of specific dollar amount + compressed timeframe + single lever creates irresistible pattern-break curiosity.
hook_test.why_it_works: Three cognitive triggers fire simultaneously: specificity ($47K not 'a lot'), impossibility compression (24 hours), and minimum effort fantasy (1 prompt). Viewers must resolve the dissonance — scroll-stopping is involuntary.
